title: Bermuda Triangle anomalies

tellings.quote: there seem there's there's data there's evidence of anomalies.
there is a little patch around the Bermuda Triangle sim or like near there where there is just tons of electromagnetic anomalies going on.
tellings.difference: Relayed by Michels from a former NASA engineer and specified as electromagnetic anomalies, not as official data.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the general claim that there are anomalies in the Bermuda Triangle region.

as_told.title: Former NASA engineer on electromagnetic anomalies near Bermuda Triangle

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, talks with podcast host Jesse Michels about the Bermuda Triangle, a stretch of the Atlantic Ocean with a long reputation for strange disappearances. Gallaudet says there seems to be data and evidence of anomalies there, which would mean something unexplained really is going on in that area.
